strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Ngh, what could they be doing in a place like this!?
Wow, it's falling apart inside.
Ngh... because we couldn't stop Gato's nuclear attack...!
These guys... what do they want in such a wrecked place!?
I can't believe Konpei Island is under attack again...!
Ah! Again...!
Ruri, analyze the enemy as soon as you lock on!
Checking data. Unidentified... the most unidentified of the lot.
Hm, that enemy...!?
It's those Einst guys!? What the heck are they doing!
Are they searching for something...!?
The Einst...!? What are they doing in a place like this!?
I don't know... but are they investigating something!?
...A will...?
Brother, what's wrong?
I've fought them a few times myself...
But back then, they were unlike rock or steel...
Like inorganic matter. Lifeless things...
You mean... unmanned machines, like the Battas...?
What nonsense are you spouting? You guys have machine bodies yourselves.
Shinobu! ...Sorry, Brother Rom. This guy's got no tact...
Did he say something wrong? ...He's got a foul mouth, sure.
Life... Whether the body that holds it is flesh and bone
or machinery, it is the stirring of the soul, there all the same...
Conversely, even a body of flesh without that stirring isn't truly alive...
Is that it?
What's with all the deep talk!? We're launching, right!?
Listen for once, Koji!
You can learn a lot from what Rom says, you know?
So, Rom, you're saying they've changed from before?
I can't tell the difference at all.
Me neither...
Rom! Explain it, will ya!
...I don't fully understand it myself... but I sense a clear will in them.
Captain, do you understand?
Martial arts hone the mind; it's said they can let one sense the unseen.
If Tenku Chushin Ken is as superior a martial art
as Dr. Tarsan says... then perhaps.
Things sharing the same element might well recognize each other...
In this case... life force, perhaps?
Caution is important, but debating here won't get us anywhere, will it?
Look, some of the kids have already rushed out.
I knew it...!
Hm!? Did you hear something, Excellen!?
Did you catch it? "Power"... or maybe "from blood"?
No, I didn't hear anything. But Raideen is reacting.
...This...
We can't dawdle! Kappei, Keiko! What are you doing!
We're going too! Let's go, everyone!
Either way, we intercept! Agreed, Captain!
Right, all units, launch! Spread out and intercept the enemy!
Whoa! More of them!
What the!? Where were they hiding!?
Judau, I'm scared! There's definitely something wrong with those!
...Hmph. Numbers don't faze me, but... there's a nasty, grating feeling...
Lining up in droves, all numbers and nothing else!
Don't panic! Focus on taking them down one by one!
Pow...er... is...
What is that!? It's creepy!
What on earth are these things...
Con...tained...
Trying to tell us something... No, that's not it...!?
...What is it, Raideen... What are you...
Whoaaa, those plant-looking ones showed up too!
Whaaat!? More enemies?
More. Lots more.
Geez! If you're coming out, come out all at once!
Though it'd be a problem if they did.
Why would monsters like these be in a place like this!?
Iron Mask's mobile armor was monstrous too...
but these are real monsters.
If they snipe us from far away... that's bad...!
Lieutenant, calm down.
...Has... not...
Ngh... again? What is it?
The enemy has long-range attacks. We'll close in all at once...!
Been waiting for this! ...is what I'd like to say, but there's a lot of 'em.
Koji! What good is it if you lose your nerve!?
Heh, leave it to me... is what I'd say, but we may be outnumbered.
Geez, Tetsuya! What good is it if you talk like that!
That's right, this isn't like you! Let's go!
If that's the plan, it's our specialty!
Step in fast... and shoot, shoot, shoot!
If our Distortion Fields... hold up, that is.
It seems the enemy granted our request and came out all at once.
Huh... you mean... by popular request?
Ngh... For a coincidence, this is...!
Geez, Captain! Don't say unnecessary things!
...Everyone... don't lose!
Waaah, so it's my fault after all!?
...Sou...ght...
(...Not contained... Sought...? Are those... linking up as words...?)
Damn things never end! When the hell did so many get in here!?
Seems they like playing hide-and-seek.
Hey, hey, come on! Any more of these and we're in real trouble!
Bright...?
The ones occupying Jaburo... are this same mysterious enemy force.
If the inside of Jaburo is the same as it is here at Solomon...
What are you doing, Bright!? Give us some cover!
The captain must've noticed too. This enemy that pops up out of nowhere...
Jaburo is in the same state...
It's fair to say the ground and space are more closely linked than we think.
Forget connections. Right now I'd rather cut ties with these guys!
But unless we figure out what these things are and what they want...
we'll have to keep fighting them forever! ...Ngh!?
Thing...
I knew it... Those words do mean something...!?
That red one...!
It's back again!?
Ugh... Raideen's reaction is strongest with that one...! That thing is...!
...This is not the place I sought... This power... is unnecessary.
Hey, you!
...But... my goal lies elsewhere. ...Yes, it's you, Excellen...
What are you doing!? Intercept it!
That red thing... What the hell is it!?
Come to me... Excellen.
...You shouldn't tease your big sister so much, little girl.
...Kyosuke... won't listen to what I say... But...
What are you talking about? Explain it so I can understand too.
You'll understand soon. ...Yes, soon. Because... you are...
...!? Wait! ...What on earth is going on!?
(I'll understand soon...? Is that why I can hear those things' voices...?
No, that's not it... It's something more, something else...
Kyosuke... What's happening around us...?)
...Was that the last of them?
Phew... Hopefully no more of them show up.
Hellooo, if there's any more of you, come on out!
Knock it off already.
Yeah, cut it out, Yurika.
...No readings... Looks like it's over.
How'd so many sneak in here? Can't let your guard down for a second.
Well, it may not look like it, but this is Solomon... a fortress, after all.
I suppose there were plenty of places to hide...
The nuclear attack by the RX-78-GP02A, the Gundam GP02A,
left it with almost no function as a base, though.
But it's also true that it made the place easier to hide in.
Besides, this place was called Konpei Island or something, right?
Wasn't it beat up to begin with? Looks like you could get in anywhere.
...Is that all it is?
Excellen...? What's wrong?
Something about how they moved this time doesn't add up... ...And that girl...
They just attacked without warning like always, didn't they?
But... didn't Rom say at first that he sensed some kind of purpose?
You mean when Rom said he sensed some kind of will?
Now that you mention it... you did say that, didn't you, Rom?
...Yes. I can't say anything specific... but most likely.
What do you think it is, Master Rom?
I'd like to know too. Those things only ever attacked mindlessly before,
so why did they attack with some kind of purpose this time...?
...Did something happen at this base in the past?
It saw fierce fighting in the last war. It's also where the Solar System,
a weapon that amplifies sunlight, was used.
And then... Gato used a nuke here too...
Yes, it hit the outside, yet the shockwave reached deep inside...
Terrifying destructive power.
So it became a weapons testing ground of sorts. Is that connected?
Sniffing out past events at a location and appearing there...
Is something like that even possible...?
Wouldn't it be obvious at a glance if we looked at the records?
It's not like the records have been erased.
Either way... we don't even have a clue yet as to who they are.
Beats me. Anyway, Bright, should we really be loafing around here?
There's no point fiddling with stuff we can't figure out.
Understood. All right, all units, return to the ship.
I'll contact Luna II and have them tighten their watch on Solomon.
For now, on to the next point, then.
(Power, This, Power, Not, Contained, Sought, Thing...
Power... not contained in this power... the thing... I sought...?
And that girl who appeared afterward... I'm... her goal...?)
